Clear Uploaded Files?

This will permanently remove the uploaded operational files for the selected hub from this device and delete them from the cloud bucket.

Will be cleared
•LM Inventory
•Incoming Inventory
•Incoming From-To / Linehaul
•Saved upload history and undo data
Will NOT be cleared: Rider data, town arrangements, zone settings, and planning exceptions.
The uploaded file is also deleted from the Cloudflare bucket, so other devices will no longer receive it. Other devices keep any copy they already loaded until they press CLEAR.
